So an operator who does nothing still has every managed resource activated, and nothing fails or needs migrating. correction.statement: Crossplane 2.0 automatically creates a default managed resource activation policy (MRAP) that activates all managed resources (`*`). Customizing it before installing v2 providers is optional, so an operator who does nothing has no operational consequence.

consequence.statement: If the operator does nothing, the default MRAP that Crossplane v2 creates automatically activates all managed resources (`*`). The upgrade guide describes replacing it with a targeted MRAP as optional, for better cluster resource efficiency. Nothing is stated to fail.
consequence.remediation: Optional: before installing v2 providers, check which managed resources you use and replace the default MRAP with a targeted one that activates only those resources (step 3 of the Crossplane v2 upgrade guide).
